taskDomains.conceal-contents: Actual Bag operator's DEX check, with Sleight of Hand only if the task genuinely qualifies, to physically arrange real noncreature cargo using actual folds, lining or other cargo against ordinary inspection. No secret compartment or detection contest is created.
taskDomains.organize-contents: Actual Bag operator's INT check for genuinely difficult sorting/packing of known accessible cargo, or DEX for difficult physical placement/separation.
